speaker: charlie
text: Sticking with the Reef, Aussie marine scientists have been busy breeding what they're calling super coral, strains that can handle warmer water a lot better than the usual stock. It is basically giving the Reef a bit of a gym membership before the heat of summer hits.

speaker: alice
text: I love that, tough coral for tough times. Researchers have been collecting spawn from naturally heat resistant colonies and growing them up in labs before planting them back out on damaged reef sections.

speaker: charlie
text: It is slow, patient work, but it is exactly the kind of quiet science that doesn't make huge headlines yet could end up saving one of the most important ecosystems going. We will keep you posted as those super corals get out into the wild.
